description: This Java class 'CustomerOptionValueServiceImpl' implements business logic for managing customer option values, including CRUD operations and dependencies on DAOs and other services within a sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing customer option value management, extending generic sales manager services and providing methods for listing, saving, updating, deleting, and fetching customer option values.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customer option values for a given store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new customer option value or updates an existing one.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer option value along with associated attributes and option sets.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a customer option value by store and code.
